correctness.rationale: The Fourier coefficient of the free lattice propagator gives probability J_n(2|h|t)^2. Full re-preparation makes the next trial independent of the first pair (duration, outcome). The renewal mean uses the unconditional first duration 1/r, not independence of duration and outcome within a trial. With a=r/(2|h|), the Laplace transform is Q_(n-1/2)(1+a^2/2)/pi, so the success probability is a times that transform and the stated normalization follows. The cosine and positive toroidal integrals have the same normalization: setting rho=exp(-eta), the cosine coefficient expands using the binomial series for the two factors (1-rho exp(±i theta))^(-1/2), and the positive integral with exp(-t)=rho*s reproduces those coefficients times pi via the beta integral. The success rate rq tends to zero at both ends for n>=1 (the fast-rate behavior is q~binom(2n,n)(|h|/r)^(2n)), ensuring an attained finite optimum. At alpha=na and beta=n eta, translation of the rescaled lower endpoint bounds the positive integrand by exp(-(s+beta))/sqrt(s(s+2 beta)), uniformly dominated on compact interior alpha intervals, and gives the K_0 limit. For a<=1 the global bound alpha^2 K_0(c alpha) tends to zero at both alpha boundaries; for a>=1 the bound C n^2 exp(-(n-1)c) tends to zero uniformly. Hence no sequence of global optimizers can escape. The derivative of R=alpha K_1/K_0 is alpha[(K_1/K_0)^2-1]>0; R ranges from 0 to infinity, giving the unique limiting optimizer and convergence for every minimizing sequence. Independent numerical calculation checked alpha=1.552651255645364 and constant 3.262211749335942; the frozen numerical script was inspected, not executed. Neither numeric check substitutes for compactness and the limiting proof.

originality.rationale: Poisson probing, renewal, the single-trial lattice Bessel amplitude, and the Laplace/Legendre identity are not new. The checked literature and catalogue do not give the globally optimized large-distance theorem for this precisely renewed exponential one-shot protocol on the infinite line. The surviving claim is the compactness and sharp asymptotic for all global optimizers and their value, not priority for its constituent identities or a general advantage over other restart laws.
residual_risks: Bounded search and targeted source passages do not establish exhaustive priority. An unindexed equivalently normalized lattice result remains possible.
The theorem does not claim a unique optimizer for any given finite distance or superiority over nonexponential waiting laws and repeated-monitoring protocols.

value.rationale: This isolates a meaningful gap between ballistic propagation and physical first-detection time in a specified renewal experiment. The sharp quadratic law and rate give more than a formal stationary point or an upper estimate at one chosen rate: every physical-rate optimum has the same scaling, with no unexamined parameter escape. That distinction is useful for comparisons among explicitly different quantum detection protocols.
